verdicts.reason: Both reuse the same stacked layout: a beige block with an odd notch in the top-left, a tiny pool crop shoved against the top-right edge, the house photo, then the headline. Neither has an accent sitting close to the photo the way the original does, and the bottom third is dead space. A at least keeps a beige block bottom-right to anchor that empty area, though it sits awkwardly flush against the canvas edge. B drops that block, leaves a large blank bottom, and adds a stray beige sliver under the pool crop.
